strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Whoa, wh-what!?
The Shining Gundam... activated? Is Domon calling it!?
Eeek! Who's attacking? Huh!?
Death Army...!? And also...
What is this!?
I can handle a few Death Army too!
Did we get it!?
Looks like it.
The Devil Gundam has the Three Great Theories.
It's too early to relax!
Domon...
...Brother.
Raaaain!
Domon!
Hurry and get into the Shining, Domon!
I know!
Rain! Leave the rest to me!
All right. The rest is up to you, Domon!
Yeah, I'll drag out the Devil Gundam and Master Asia!
Isn't it about time you showed yourself!? Master Asiaaa!
Domon... It seems today, at last, we must settle this.
I will never call you Master again!
Undefeated of the East... Master Asia!
Here in the training grounds where I raised you, I'll bury you in style!!
He shares your blood, yet his power is worlds beyond yours.
Realize how green you are, and bow down before him!!
Kyoji...
Fuhahahaha... Fuhahahaha...
What's so funny...? What's so funny!!
Listen! Because of you, Mother died and Father was frozen...
And chasing you landed me in this mess! You've no right to laugh!!
I'll never forgive you... I'll smash you to pieces!!
Heh heh... Hehehe...
(Just as I thought, my eye does not fail me.
Consumed by anger, he's merely wasting his energy.
Now is the time to strike...)
You're mine!!
Ngh...
G-Gundam... Spiegel!? ...Schwarz!
You fool... After all my warnings, why did you trigger Super Mode...?
I'm sorry... I'm hopeless. My training wasn't enough...
Hopeless, truly hopeless, Domon!
Gundam Spiegel saved your life, and your anger has subsided, yet
you're wide open and look at you! Now, I'll snap your neck!
Domon, remember! That moment...
That instant in the cave... The instant of Meikyo Shisui!
Meikyo... Shisui...
(...Huh!? Father... Mother... I... I'm!)
(Domon, die with a quiet heart!)
(Die...? Me? That's right, it's the same as that time... just like then...)
(Hang in there, Domon! Don't you lose!)
(Rain!!)
I see it!
I see it! The single drop of water!!
Wuoooh! What is this... this spirit!? It's different from before... Could it be!?
Domon, you've done it... That is the true Super Mode.
With the Meikyo Shisui mind, you can defeat the Devil Gundam...
The Gandor!?
Are you all right? Mikamura, Kasshu?
Ah, yes... But why are you here?
We picked up abnormal vibration waves near here. So we came.
Well, no wonder, with that thing around.
What on earth is that?
That's an offshoot of the Devil Gundam!
Ngh, I can't afford to lose the Devil Gundam in a place like this.
I knew it, there are still more of them.
Looks like it's not just the Death series...
That enemy...
The Einst, which have been appearing in space too...
Are you saying the Einst and the Devil Gundam are connected?
Leave that for later. For now, let's just launch!
The rest can wait. Let's launch, Jun.
All Gandor units, cover Kasshu and the others and take out the enemy!
I have a bad feeling about this... Let's go.
Domon... Do you really think you can defeat me with skills like those?
Yeah. I won't hold back anymore! I'll defeat you, no matter what!
What!? Even after all the damage we did!?
What on earth is happening?
I don't know, Princess.
Looks like it recovers once it takes a certain amount of damage...
The Devil Gundam has a self-evolution function.
So it's evolved since it appeared at Jaburo...
DG Cells aren't all-powerful!
Do something while its regeneration is weakened!
Got it. We just go all out and take it down, right!
Tobikage!
So you've shown up, Ninja Warrior.
Right now only my Blast Dragon can combine, but...
Mike, please don't say such timid things.
With Joe and the others gone, you've gotta step up.
Kyoji... no, Brother. I'll end this now...
Nnngh... that I... I, Master Asia of the Undefeated of the East school...
But, however!
It can still move, in that state...
Of course! Have you forgotten my name!?
I've never known defeat! I am Master Asia, Undefeated of the East!
Master...
Domon. I shall leave this place, but your future will not change...
no matter how you struggle...
It's fading... My anger, my sorrow, my revenge... all fading away...
Ahh, my Devil Gundam...
This is unseemly, Master Asia. You were beaten by your former pupil...
It's not gonna come back to life again, is it?
N-No...
The Devil Gundam's reading... It's gone...
We did it! Wait, hey...
Something's coming!
Alchemie...!
That light just now, wasn't it...
The light of the Aura Road...
Which means those guys came from Byston Well?
I guess that's what it means...
Time... already...
Time... already...?
I see... I didn't make it in time...
Didn't make it? Don't tell me... the Devil Gundam!?
So you've returned... But...
the ones you left behind couldn't protect the Devil Gundam!
I see... They were failures after all...
Ngh... That light again?
Kurojishi? Big Bro!?
Hold on... So does that mean...?
Joe! Look over there! It's the Elshank!
Joe...!? Is that you, Joe!?
Princess Romina!? So we really made it back to the surface?
Captain! You're safe!
More or less.
Captain Amuro! That red machine we were just fighting...!
You mean it came up with us...?
I brought along some things I didn't need...
So bringing the Captain and the others along was
not part of Alchemie's plan...
It can't be helped... I have no more business here...
W-Wait! What are you...?
Kyosuke... I wanted to know more... about you...
Tch...
Master...
Looks like we've driven off every enemy in this airspace.
Anyway, I'm glad. Everyone made it back safely.
Yeah. Welcome back, Chris.
All right, everyone return to the Gandor. We'll talk details after that.
All units, return to the ship.
